annotation.description:
Showing a desk at home. A woman enters from the right and sits down at a chair on the left of the frame, holding her head, seemingly contemplating. Red old school lamp in the middle of the desk, illuminating the room while leaving a small vignette at the edges of the viewport. A window to the left also lets some light in. TV hanging from the top, only partly visible.
A second shot is showing the woman from another perspective, after a short moment she stares into the camera and fixes her bad posture as if she's been caught
